hero.title: Build with Antigua Tech Labs
hero.description: Use our public API contract, structured errors, and safe validation mode to integrate project inquiries into automated workflows.

overview.title: A small, explicit API surface
overview.description: The public API currently focuses on contact inquiries. Every implemented behavior is documented in OpenAPI and designed to return machine-readable responses.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: The public contact endpoint does not currently require credentials. Do not send bearer tokens or API keys. If authenticated APIs are introduced, this portal and the OpenAPI contract will be updated first.

endpoint.title: Contact API
endpoint.description: Submit a project inquiry for delivery to our team, or validate the same payload safely with dry-run mode.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the person submitting the inquiry.

quickstart.title: Quickstart
quickstart.description: Start with the safe validation mode. It uses the production schema and error contract without sending email.

sandbox.title: Safe sandbox
sandbox.description: Add dryRun=true to validate a request. A successful response includes sandbox: true and confirms that no message was delivered.
sandbox.warning: Remove dryRun only when you intend to send a real inquiry to Antigua Tech Labs.

errors.title: Structured errors
errors.description: Errors always include a stable code, a readable message, a resolution hint, and optional field-level details.

cli.title: Official CLI package
cli.description: The atl CLI can inspect documentation, retrieve the OpenAPI contract, and submit or validate contact requests. The package source is available now; npm installation will be documented after publication.
